hints: Press E (or the round button) at a door to go inside. Machines and counters are used from inside.
The Jobs Board in Dataran Sunway Square is the quickest way to your first ringgit.
Deliveries pay more the further they go. Ride your bicycle (key 1) to finish them faster.
Car washes pay a bonus for a fast AND perfect wash. Soap every spot before you rinse.
Every 5 jobs of one kind raises your job level, and the pay goes up with it.
Manifest with the − key while you take a break: you earn a little every second.
Your 📱 HustlePhone (P or Tab) has Daily rewards, Quests, Skills, Titles and the Handbook.
Claim your Daily reward every day: the streak gets better each day you come back.
Hustle Harder (📱 → Skills) makes every job pay more. Buy it early.
Kopi Kaw gives +50% job pay for 10 minutes. Drink it before a long job run.
Drink a Luck Potion before rolling an expensive crate, not a cheap one.
Net worth counts your cash AND what your items would sell for at Kedai Pajak.
Sell duplicate items at Kedai Pajak Untung, or scrap them for shards.
Each crate has its own Item Index page. Finishing a page pays 50× the crate price.
The pasar malam opens in the evening (5 PM – 2 AM in-game). Buy a stall there for RM 300.
Perfect dishes pay 1.8×, and every Perfect in a row adds to your combo.
Watch for the food blogger at your stall: a perfect dish for them pays 5×.
Ingredients are 20% cheaper in person at Gergasi Hypermarket than ordered by phone.
Hire a cook (📱 → Business → Staff) and your stall keeps selling while you do jobs.
Book a 🛵 Ronda ride from your phone to get across town fast.
Sidewalks are as fast as roads on a motorbike. Grass slows you down a bit.
Footbridges cross the big highway to PJU 3 and Ant Palms. Look for the white bridges.
Press M for the big map. The big signs show where to work, shop and set up a stall.
Tap the 🎯 Next Goal card to point an arrow at where to go next.
Nights too long? Open the 📱 → Clock and vote to skip to morning.
Wear a title (📱 → Titles) and it shows over your head for everyone.
Chat with Enter. Emotes are on Q; sit, sleep or dance to hang out.
People wandering around town sometimes need a hand. Talk to them for small jobs.
Your game saves every minute and whenever you log out.
Buy a home (look for 🏷️ FOR SALE), then rent it out or run an Airbnb from 📱 → Properties.
Airbnb stars come from comfort, matching themes, rare furniture, amenities and cleanliness. Decorate mode shows what to add next.
Your homes keep earning while you're logged out (at half speed, up to 8 hours).

handbook.title: Getting started
steps: Move with WASD / arrow keys, or the joystick on a phone.
Press E (or tap the round action button) to use things and go through doors.
Your 🎯 Next Goal card (top left) always says what to do next. Tap it for an arrow pointing the way.
Open the 📱 HustlePhone with P or Tab. Claim your 🎁 Daily reward first.
Press M for the map. Big signs mark jobs, shops and stall spots.

handbook.title: Your first money: jobs
steps: Go to the 📋 Jobs Board in Dataran Sunway Square (where you start).
Pick Delivery: collect food at the shop with the yellow marker, then drop it at the house.
Or go into Kilat Car Wash (east along the street) and wash cars: soap, rinse, buff.
Every 5 jobs of a kind levels the job up and it pays more.
Buy Hustle Harder in 📱 → Skills so every job pays more.

handbook.title: Crates and items
steps: Go into Kedai Runcit Pak Abu and use the Capsule Machine (RM 20 a roll).
Items have rarities, from Common up to Mythic and beyond. Rarer = worth more.
Wear hats, glasses and backpacks from your 🎒 Bag (B).
Sell or scrap what you don't want inside Kedai Pajak Untung.
Later: the Lucky Bag at the pasar malam and the Mystery Box in Piramid Mall.

handbook.title: Running a food stall
steps: Reach the Hustler stage (RM 2,000 net worth), then buy a pasar malam spot (📱 → Business).
Buy ingredients: cheapest in person at Gergasi Hypermarket (BUY STOCK on the map).
Open your stall in the evening; customers queue up.
Press E at your stall to cook: each step is a quick mini-game. Perfect pays the most.
Hire a cook so it keeps selling while you're away; upgrade to a food truck and kopitiam later.

handbook.title: Homes, rent and Airbnb
steps: From Towkay Kecil you can afford a studio in the Ant Palms condos (HOMES FOR SALE on the map).
Walk to the door, press E, and buy a unit.
📱 → Properties: rent it to a tenant (steady daily rent) or run it as an Airbnb (more money, more work).
Airbnb: go inside and press 🛠️ Decorate. Every essential (bed, toilet, shower, kitchen, aircond, wifi) is needed for a good rating.
Buy furniture at IKEJA; rare themed pieces come from the Mall Mystery Box. Clean after guests, or hire a cleaner.
Homes keep earning while you're offline. Welcome back with a Lucky Spin to double it!

handbook.title: Levels, skills and stages
steps: Everything you do gives XP. Levels unlock new crates, jobs and stall tiers.
Your wealth stage goes up with net worth: Budak Baru → Hustler → Towkay Kecil → ...
Spend money on Hustle Skills (📱 → Skills) for permanent bonuses.
Do the 3 daily quests (📱 → Quests) for big bonuses every day.
Potions (Kopi Kaw, Luck Potion) give short boosts. Time them well.

handbook.title: Getting around
steps: Your bicycle is on hotbar key 1. Hop on and off any time.
Order a motorbike from 📱 → Ronda when you can afford it, or book a ride.
Roads and sidewalks are fastest; grass slows vehicles a little.
Footbridges cross the highway to the east side (PJU 3, Ant Palms).
Under a flyover the road above turns see-through so you can see yourself.

handbook.title: Playing together
steps: Everyone on the same WiFi joins the same town.
Chat with Enter; emotes on Q.
When it's night, anyone can start a vote to skip to morning (📱 → Clock). Most players online must agree.
Players who go into a building disappear outside. Go in too and you'll see them inside.
